_comment: Key taxonomy — maps key shapes, agent archetypes, and services. Static registry. NO secret values.

bearer.description: Single API key string passed as Authorization: Bearer header or query param
bearer.rotation: Replace key in store, update all consumers
bearer.risk: Leaked key = full access until rotated

oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials JSON with client_id, client_secret, and refresh_token
oauth.rotation: Refresh token auto-rotates access tokens; client secret rotation requires re-consent
oauth.risk: Refresh token = persistent access; client secret alone is not enough

service_account.description: Service account JSON with private key for JWT-based auth (no user interaction)
service_account.rotation: Generate new key in provider console, delete old key
service_account.risk: Private key = full service account permissions; hardest to scope

keypair.description: Access key ID + secret access key pair
keypair.rotation: Create new pair, migrate consumers, delete old pair
keypair.risk: Both halves needed; leaking one half is limited risk

derived.description: Keys that exist because another integration exists — webhook secrets, JWT signing keys, encryption keys
derived.rotation: Rotation may require updating all signed/encrypted data
derived.risk: Often overlooked in rotation schedules; compromise is silent

builder.description: Deploys, tests, manages CI/CD pipelines. Writes code that ships.

analyst.description: Pulls data, builds reports, runs dashboards. Reads more than writes.

operator.description: Manages billing, CRM, invoicing, subscriptions. Touches money and customer records.

researcher.description: Calls inference APIs, runs embeddings, evaluates models. Token-intensive.

communicator.description: Sends messages, manages notifications, handles email and chat integrations.

guardian.description: Manages auth flows, signs tokens, handles encryption. Security-critical.

stripe.notes: Publishable key is client-safe; secret key is server-only

firebase.notes: Service account JSON; same key works for Firestore, Auth, Storage

supabase.notes: URL + key pair; service key bypasses RLS

pinax.notes: Field encryption key and JWT signing secret; derived from CRM infra

pinax-google.notes: OAuth client for Pinax Google integration

ga4.notes: OAuth or service account; adapter auto-detects

anthropic.notes: Two keys: Bifrost-specific and shared across ArtForge/MoleculeEQ/ml-intern

huggingface.notes: Model hub access, inference API, Spaces

openai.notes: PromptLabs multi-provider; used for model comparison

aws.notes: PromptLabs Bedrock access; keypair must be stored as two secrets
